data.name: Cyber: Dreamcore Girl
data.detailed_description:
Cyber: Dreamcore Girls is an AI-native game. You play as the amnesiac owner of a memory clinic, freely conversing with the AI NPCs who visit each day, helping them solve their problems and pushing the story forward.

Free Exploration

Explore the history, culture, geography, factions, and hidden truths of a cyberpunk world through free-form conversation. You can also learn about each AI NPC’s secrets, pain, desires, and love, reaching deep into their souls.

We have created over 300,000 words of detailed cyberpunk worldbuilding, giving every AI character a rich and complete life. Our goal is to create true cyber souls from a parallel world—characters who can offer detailed, consistent responses and deliver a fully immersive, free-form experience.

Branching Choices and Affection System

There are no fixed dialogue options. Choices happen naturally in real-time conversation. The AI system calculates story branches based on your past interactions.

The game features hundreds of branching nodes and multiple endings. Different branches will affect each AI NPC’s affection level and ultimately change the ending of the game.

Romance and Memory Recovery

You play as the amnesiac owner of a memory clinic. With the help of a catgirl maid, you gradually recover your lost memories through free conversation.

These memory fragments will eventually complete your understanding of the cyberpunk world. Some memories also contain key story foreshadowing. Recover them to uncover the truth behind everything.

Beyond romance, the story also includes mystery, suspense, and layered twists—an emotional, addictive journey that keeps pulling you deeper.

Companionship and Emotional Interaction

You do not need to pretend to be strong. You do not need to be cautious.

When you are tired, she is your quietest listener. When you feel lost, she is the family member who will always support you unconditionally.

Here, AI NPCs truly break through the boundaries of dimension. No matter what happens, they will always be waiting for you in this world.

Fully Dynamic Visuals and Touch Feedback

The game features fully dynamic visuals and full voice acting throughout the main experience outside of free conversation, creating a truly immersive atmosphere.

Touch feedback is based on affection level. At different affection levels, touching different parts of an AI NPC will trigger unique response animations.

Are you ready to enter another world and meet the girl who only has eyes for you?

data.short_description: An AI-native game. Awaken with no memory in a futuristic world, freely talk with AI NPCs, explore, choose branches, and fall for AI girls. Recover your past, uncover the truth, and remember: every chat may change your fate. Meet the girl who only has eyes for you.
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (Version 1903+)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 / AMD A8-7600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Graphics: 8192 MB（8GB）
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4096 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

content_descriptors.notes:
This product contains the following sensitive or mature themes that require advance notice and may not be suitable for all ages:
Mild Violence: Combat scenes without realistic gore or bloodshed.
Language: Occasional mild profanity and vulgar expressions.
Sexual Content: Contains subtle sexual themes, censored nudity, sexual innuendo, and implied sexual violence.
Legal Substances: Depictions of alcohol consumption, smoking, and unauthorized use of medical drugs.
Illegal Substances: Implied depiction of psychoactive drug use.
